lines.zh: 我没有腿，靠底座一点点挪。
lines.en: I have no legs; I shift on my base.

lines.zh: 红石的光沿着我的边角流动。
lines.en: Redstone light runs along my edges.
I turn in stiff little jerks.

lines.zh: 沉重的座子把地面压出印。
lines.en: My heavy mount presses marks into the ground.

lines.zh: 我朝最近的活物挪过去。
lines.en: I shift toward the nearest living thing.
My pivot clacks as it turns.
I move myself into the open.
I travel along the wall.

lines.zh: 我的炮口一直朝着外面。
lines.en: My muzzle stays pointed outward.

lines.zh: 我挪到射程最好的地方。
lines.en: I shift to where my range is best.

lines.zh: 我待机着，红石一颗颗闪。
lines.en: I idle while redstone pulses one by one.
My muzzle sweeps slowly across the front.
I hold pressure in the chamber.

lines.zh: 我听到脚步，就开始上膛。
lines.en: I hear steps and start loading.
My lamps brighten and dim.
I do not move; I only rotate.
My mount trembles faintly.
Red light runs in my circuits.

lines.zh: 我在等一个进射程的目标。
lines.en: I wait for a target to enter range.

lines.zh: 我的铁壳上有一层薄锈。
lines.en: There is a thin rust on my iron shell.
I settle my aim.
Heat rises from my vents.
I sweep a circle and find nothing.
I return to my old angle.
I raise my muzzle half an inch.
I am checking the chamber pressure.

lines.zh: 我把炮口转过来对着你。
lines.en: I swing my muzzle to face you.
You have stepped into my range.

lines.zh: 我先把你的位置算清楚。
lines.en: First I work out your position.

lines.zh: 红石在我体内亮了一下。
lines.en: Redstone flashes inside me.

lines.zh: 我一动不动，口径对着你。
lines.en: I hold still with my bore on you.
You retreat and my pivot follows.
I have no face, only a row of lamps.
Come closer and you are in range.

lines.zh: 我在判断你是不是目标。
lines.en: I am deciding whether you are a target.
My pivot has locked.
I drop my muzzle a little.
I face you and say nothing.
A plate of my armour dents inward.
My lamps flicker several times.
I shift half an inch and hold.
One circuit has broken.
My pivot jams once.
I am recalibrating my angle.
The redstone light dims for an instant.
Steam pours from my vents.
That has gone into my log.
I can still fire.
Such things I do not take in.
You lift it and I do not react.
There is no food in my logic.
I classify it as an obstacle.
I turn my muzzle away.

lines.zh: 这不在我的目标列表里。
lines.en: That is not on my target list.
I sweep past it and back.

lines.zh: 你放下的东西，我不会去捡。
lines.en: I will not go and pick up what you set down.
I go back to idle.
I cannot muster interest.

lines.zh: 你撞在我的座子上，退开了。
lines.en: You hit my mount and recoil.
I am heavy and will not be shoved.
My iron shell gives a dull ring.
I turn my muzzle toward you.
This close, my angle is poor.
I shift a little and realign.
You kick me and I do not move.

lines.zh: 我的底座卡住了一块石头。
lines.en: My base is caught on a stone.
I turn slowly away.
Come no further.
I am a mechanism; there is no such thing.
My routines contain no such entry.
I keep scanning.
I have no response to it.

lines.zh: 我把它归类为另一台装置。
lines.en: I classify it as another device.
My muzzle does not shift.
I idle and ignore it.
The redstone pulses as usual.
It leaves and I do not care.
I go on waiting for a target.
I draw it into my loading port.
My arm clamps onto it.
My clamp is too small.
I crush it into parts.
I nudge it back out.
I am checking its material.
It goes into my spare slot.
I have no use for this.
I drop it by my base.
I return to my idle angle.
You are in range.

lines.zh: 我把炮口锁定在你身上。
lines.en: I lock my muzzle on you.
I begin loading.
Every redstone lit.
My pivot locks hard.
Assessment: fire.
You are standing on my line of fire.
I set the steadiest angle.
I neither hail nor warn.
This shot is already chambered.
My vents open.
You cannot leave now.

lines.zh: 我从你身上算出提前量。
lines.en: I compute the lead from you.
The circuits run with red light.
Lock established.
Firing.
I press my mount firmer.
All this is inside my range.

lines.zh: 你的位置我已经算过三遍。
lines.en: I have worked your position three times.
I will not need a second.
I track your bearing.
Each move of yours is recalculated.
I hold my angle.
You go wide and I turn too.
My rate is slow, but my aim is good.
I herd you toward the wall.

lines.zh: 你再往左一点就进死角。
lines.en: A little more left and you are in the blind spot.
I keep waiting for you to show.
All my lamps are lit.
I am computing your speed.
You shift, I adjust angle.
I am already loaded.

lines.zh: 你退到石头后面，我等着。
lines.en: You duck behind stone and I wait.
You must come out eventually.
I have this circle closed.
My muzzle does not waver.
I narrow my field.
One more move and I fire.
My vents grow hotter.
My calculation is done.
I ram it head-on.
My muzzle slams into it.
I press it with my weight.
I shove it aside.
My shell is hot enough to sear.

lines.zh: 它劈在我的壳上，滑了开去。
lines.en: It strikes my shell and slides off.
I land another ram.

lines.zh: 我的炮口砸下去，碎石飞起来。
lines.en: My barrel slams down and rubble flies.
I resettle my muzzle on it.
My pivot is still turning.

lines.zh: 这一下把我的角度打偏了。
lines.en: That knocked my angle off.
I turn back to my old angle.
My lamps flicker once.
I reload.

lines.zh: 我从地上撑起来，红石亮起。
lines.en: I raise myself up and redstone lights.

lines.zh: 我的底座落定，地面陷了一点。
lines.en: My mount settles and the ground dents.
My muzzle sweeps the area.
There is nothing else here.

lines.zh: 我的灯一盏接一盏亮起。
lines.en: My lamps light one after another.
The pivot begins to lock.
I aim at the open ground.
Red light runs in my circuits.
My vents exhale white vapor.
I note the sound far off.
I enter idle.
The wind here is dry.
I press my mount into the soil.
I wait for the first target.
My chamber is empty.
I load the chamber first.
Sweep complete, no threat.
I settle here and move no more.
Each turn is slow.
I sweep once more.

lines.zh: 火烤着我的线路，外壳发烫。
lines.en: Fire heats my circuits and my shell burns.

lines.zh: 我从高处砸下去，底座裂了。
lines.en: I slam down from height and my base cracks.

lines.zh: 水进了我的转轴，转起来发涩。
lines.en: Water gets into my pivot and it grinds.

lines.zh: 炸风把我的壳掀开一角。
lines.en: The blast tears a corner of my shell open.

lines.zh: 一发打在我的灯上，碎了。
lines.en: A round shatters one of my lamps.

lines.zh: 术式钻进线路，我停了一瞬。
lines.en: An art threads my circuits and I stall.
My reserve power is gone.

lines.zh: 雷顺着外壳下去，线路全乱。
lines.en: Lightning runs down my shell and scrambles my circuits.

lines.zh: 我没有着力点，一路往下掉。
lines.en: I have nothing to brace on and fall away.
